text: And therefore put the fear of Thee, O Lord our God, upon all Thy works and awe of Thee upon all that Thou hast created, so that all works may fear Thee and all the created bow down before Thee and all of them may be made into one group for the performance of Thy will with a complete heart, since we know, O Lord our God, that dominion lies before Thee, that strength is in Thy hand and might in Thy right hand and that Thy Name inspires with awe all that Thou
